line: Jung's passages on eight: the double quaternity and totality symbol, the Gnostic ogdoad, the eighth after seven, and Adam's ogdoadic nature; von Franz on eight.

sections.title: What Jung names
sections.line: CW10 ¶692–693 (Flying Saucers, 1958) and CW11 ¶424: eight as a double quaternity and its place in mandala symbolism; CW14 ¶8: the double quaternio or ogdoad as a totality. Jung writes no essay on eight; these are places where he names it.

quotes.quote: eight is a double quaternity and, as an individuation symbol in mandalas, plays almost as great a role as the quaternity itself
The “ogdoad,” being a double quaternity, belongs to the symbolism of the mandala
by mentioning the number eight points to the totality, the self, which is present in the Ufo projection

The double quaternio or ogdoad stands for a totality, for something that is at once heavenly and earthly, spiritual or corporeal, and is found in the “Indian Ocean,” that is to say in the unconscious.

sections.title: Gnosis and Egypt
sections.line: CW9ii ¶307: the Gnostics held, according to Irenaeus, that Sophia represents the world of the Ogdoad; a note to CW14 ¶576: the demiurge the hebdomad, Achamoth the ogdoad (Leisegang); and the Egyptian ogdoad in the Dream Analysis seminar.

quotes.quote: the Gnostics held that Sophia represents the world of the Ogdoad
The demiurge is the hebdomad, but Achamoth is the ogdoad
In Egypt, the Eight was the most sacred company of the gods, the Ogdoads

sections.title: The eighth in a series
sections.line: CW14 ¶574 and ¶579: the series of eight incarnations of the true prophet, whose eighth is Christ, and the eighth as feminine, the mother of a new series; a note to CW9i ¶242: the legend of the sleepers wavers between seven and eight.

quotes.quote: The series of eight incarnations of the “true prophet” is distinguished by the special position of the eighth, namely Christ

whereas the seven form an uninterrupted series, the step to the eighth involves hesitation or uncertainty and is a repetition of the same phenomenon that occurs with three and four (the Axiom of Maria)
This may be a cogent reason why the eighth is feminine: it is the mother of a new series
The different versions of the legend speak sometimes of seven and sometimes of eight disciples

sections.title: Adam and the inner circles
sections.line: CW14 ¶553: the tetradic and ogdoadic nature of Adam; CW14 ¶576: the names of the Ophite diagram distributed among eight inner circles.

quotes.quote: This material clearly shows the tetradic and ogdoadic nature of Adam
It is to be presumed that these names were distributed among the eight inner circles

sections.title: Von Franz on eight
sections.line: Number and Time: von Franz on the Latin octo as referring to the dual case of four, and on the eight arrangements of triple lines known as the pa-kua.

quotes.quote: Eight possible arrangements result from combinations of these triple lines, known as the pa-kua
Latin octo, “eight,” refers to the dual case (of four)
